newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: North Korea keeps expanding arms, Seoul official.
newsitem.headline: North Korea keeps expanding arms, Seoul official.

text.p: North Korea has continued to increase its arms capability by adding nine submarines and about 200 armoured vehicles to its armed forces this year, a senior Seoul government official told a seminar on Saturday.

Vice unification minister Kim Suk-woo also told the private Korea-Canada Forum that North Korea had stepped up its military threat towards the South by continuing its missile development programme, Kim's aides said.
But he did not give further details on the status of the North Korean military forces.
South and North Korea have massed heavily armed military forces near the Demilitarised Zone, a 4-km-wide buffer zone acting as the de-facto border between the two sides.
The two Koreas have been technically at war since their 1950-53 conflict ended in a truce, rather than a peace treaty.
